name: Password Recovery Request Flow Handler
summary: Provides the typed application boundary for requesting password recovery while delegating password reset mechanics to the existing password manager.
notes: The handler records the canonical non-enumerating request-accepted transition while token generation and email delivery remain in PasswordManager.
PasswordRecoveryRequestFlowHandler.TransitionKey is the implementation source of truth for this descriptor.

sourceReferences.note: Implemented typed handler and canonical transition key.
